title: Machine Learning-Guided Identification of Madecassoside as a Potential RAD51 Modulator That Sensitizes Breast Cancer Cells to Cisplatin.
authors: Oh, Minju; Jeong, Mi-Young; Choi, Jiwon
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习与分子对接筛选天然产物RAD51抑制剂，涉及RAD51-DNA核蛋白丝互作，但核心是药物筛选而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Homologous recombination (HR) is an essential pathway for preserving the genomic stability of cells by repairing DNA damage, especially double-strand breaks and interstrand crosslinks. RAD51 recombinase plays a central role in the HR pathway, and when DNA damage occurs, RAD51 binds to single-stranded DNA at the cleavage site to form a helical nucleoprotein filament. Therefore, pharmacological inhibition of RAD51 is emerging as an attractive strategy to block the repair mechanisms of cancer cells and maximize the therapeutic efficacy of conventional radiation and chemotherapy. Several RAD51 small-molecule inhibitors, including CYT-0851, B02, and IBR2, have demonstrated preclinical or early clinical efficacy, but no candidate has yet received regulatory approval. In this study, we identified a novel RAD51 inhibitor from a natural product library using an in silico workflow that combines machine learning models and molecular docking simulations. Among the five machine learning models evaluated, the random forest (RF) model showed the best overall predictive performance after SMOTE-based class balancing and near-zero variance filtering, achieving an accuracy of 0.933, sensitivity of 0.800, specificity of 1.000, Cohen's kappa of 0.842, and ROC-AUC of 0.980. Using an optimized RF model, 1142 natural compounds were virtually screened, and Madecassoside was finally selected by molecular docking analysis. Biological validation showed that MDA-MB-231 cells increased susceptibility to cisplatin after Madecassoside treatment and also markedly inhibited the formation of RAD51 foci induced by cisplatin, strongly inhibiting DNA damage repair. These findings suggest that Madecassoside is a promising RAD51-modulating lead compound that may enhance cisplatin sensitivity by impairing RAD51-mediated DNA repair.
abstract_zh: 同源重组（homologous recombination, HR）是细胞通过修复DNA损伤（尤其是双链断裂和链间交联）来维持基因组稳定性的关键通路。RAD51重组酶在HR通路中发挥核心作用，当DNA损伤发生时，RAD51结合至断裂位点的单链DNA，形成螺旋状核蛋白丝。因此，药理学抑制RAD51正成为一种有吸引力的策略，用以阻断癌细胞的修复机制并最大化常规放疗和化疗的治疗效果。包括CYT-0851、B02和IBR2在内的几种RAD51小分子抑制剂已在临床前或早期临床阶段显示出疗效，但尚无候选药物获得监管批准。在本研究中，我们通过结合机器学习模型和分子对接模拟的计算机工作流程，从天然产物库中鉴定出一种新型RAD51抑制剂。在评估的五种机器学习模型中，随机森林（random forest, RF）模型在基于SMOTE类平衡和近零方差过滤后表现出最佳的整体预测性能，准确率为0.933，灵敏度为0.800，特异度为1.000，Cohen's kappa为0.842，ROC-AUC为0.980。利用优化后的RF模型，对1142种天然化合物进行了虚拟筛选，并通过分子对接分析最终选定羟基积雪草苷（Madecassoside）。生物学验证显示，经羟基积雪草苷处理后，MDA-MB-231细胞对顺铂的敏感性增加，且显著抑制顺铂诱导的RAD51焦点形成，强力抑制DNA损伤修复。这些发现表明，羟基积雪草苷是一种有前景的RAD51调节先导化合物，可能通过损害RAD51介导的DNA修复来增强顺铂敏感性。
